thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert fired: p99 latency SLO breach (us-west, model=inference-v2). Trigger=rolling p99 > 1200ms for 10m. link: https://dash.redwood.example.com/alerts/1748888888
pagerduty: PagerDuty incident INC1748888888 created and notified the on-call.
alex: ack. I'm on it. grabbing bridge and checking autoscaler.
samir: pinging — I'm available to jump in if this looks like KV-cache or batch storm.
dana: @alex @samir can you confirm if any customer-facing errors? Support queue shows ~3 user reports for slow responses but no 5xxs.
alex: quick triage: no error spike, just tail latency increase. CPU on sidecars normal, GPU queues backed up on us-west-2b.
megan: seeing increased queue depth on router metrics: `router.request_queue_depth` up ~3x. Possibly burst from a scheduled job?
alex: checking request histogram: big jump in >2k token requests around 06:18 UTC. looks like a long-completion workload.
samir: that would blow up KV cache locality and generate extra memcopy on runtime. switching routing to smaller batches may help.
alex: starting canary reroute to smaller batch size for one shard: `--batch-size=8 -> 4` via `infractl deploy`
alex: command: ```
infractl scale --pool=us-west-rt --concurrency=4 --batch-size=4
```
ops-bridge-bot: Bridge created https://meet.redwood.example.com/bridges/1748888888 (open to oncall and eng-sre).
dana: good. also flagging customer impact: product-team says a handful of interactive features are slower but degraded, no lost data. set severity=sev2 for now.
megan: infra logs: `sidecar: evicting_kv_entries=0 -> 0`, but `worker.kv_cache.miss_rate` spiked 35%.
samir: that supports KV churn hypothesis. trying a hotkey split and warming KV for top prefixes. running warmup job: `python tools/warm_kv.py --prefixes-file /tmp/hot.txt`
samir: warmup kicked off. ETA ~2m.
alex: traffic reroute applied to 2/6 shards. latency p99 decreased from 1450ms -> 980ms on those shards. overall p99 now ~1150ms. trend is downward.
dana: thanks. please keep customers informed via status page? ops-runbook step 3 says update status.
alex: updating status page: "Investigating elevated tail latency in us-west, mitigation in progress. No errors reported." :writing_hand:
pagerduty: INC1748888888 acknowledged by alex at 06:21 UTC.
megan: autoscaler logs show an inflight scale-up request queued due to quota cap. looks like reserved capacity exhausted temporarily.
samir: can we temporarily lift quota? is there an emergency burst override?
alex: ops-bridge-bot, please apply burst-cap override for us-west pool (10m) if available.
ops-bridge-bot: Burst override applied for pool us-west for 10 minutes by alex.
megan: after override, new workers added; p99 dropped to 720ms within 90s. p95 stable ~180ms.
dana: great. still monitor for regression and document root cause. I want a blameless postmortem if KV churn + scheduled long jobs triggered this.
samir: capturing timeline and metrics. will start a ticket: TKT-1748888888 and assign to eng-runtime.
alex: planning handoff: I'm on for another 25m; @samir can you take full ownership at 07:00 UTC and continue follow-up?
samir: can do. I'll post a summary before the handoff.
dana: note to SRE: check quota automation and consider tighter preemption for long-completion requests.
megan: adding a quick alert tweak: raise anomaly threshold for long-seq bulk jobs to prevent noisy pages — will open PR for alert rules.
alex: closing steps: bridge stays open for 30m, status page will be updated to "mitigated, monitoring" once stable for 15m.
incident-bot: Incident INC1748888888 status updated: mitigated -> monitoring at 06:36 UTC.
megan: marking as monitored. will follow up with a mitigation doc and alert-tuning PR.
samir: summary I'll post in this thread before handoff: root cause hypothesis, actions taken, follow-ups.
alex: thanks team. good ride. :thumbsup:
ops-bridge-bot: Bridge will auto-close in 30 minutes unless extended.
